entities.summary: Eygló Fanndal Sturludóttir is an Icelandic weightlifter competing in the -71kg weight category. She is the 2025 European Champion in -71kg category. She has won the U23 European championship twice, in 2022 and 2024. She currently holds the Nordic senior record in the snatch 109kg, the c&j 135kg and the total at 244kg in the women's -71kg category. She was named the 2025 Icelandic Sportsperson of the Year.
